G=[[int(x) for x in r.split()] for r in grid.split('\n')]
import numpy as np
A=np.array(G)
# find connected components of nonzero colors
from collections import deque
H,W=A.shape
seen=np.zeros_like(A,bool)
fills={}
for r in range(H):
    for c in range(W):
        if A[r,c] and not seen[r,c]:
            col=A[r,c]; q=deque([(r,c)]); seen[r,c]=True; cells=[]
            while q:
                y,x=q.popleft(); cells.append((y,x))
                for dy,dx in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                    if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and not seen[ny,nx] and A[ny,nx]==col:

            ys=[p[0] for p in cells]; xs=[p[1] for p in cells]
            h=max(ys)-min(ys)+1; w=max(xs)-min(xs)+1
            interior_h=h-2; interior_w=w-2
            fill = 7 if interior_h%2==1 else 2
            fills[col]=(min(ys),min(xs),h,w,fill)
print(fills)
B=A.copy()
for col,(r0,c0,h,w,fill) in fills.items():

            B[r,c]=fill
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in B))
